mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, user_id, course_role, joined_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM course_members WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT id, course_id, user_id, course_role, joined_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM course_members WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY course_role, joined_at

SELECT cm.id, cm.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, cm.course_role, cm.joined_at FROM course_members cm JOIN users u ON u.id = cm.user_id WHERE cm.course_id = #{courseId} AND cm.status = 1 ORDER BY cm.course_role, cm.joined_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_members ( course_id, user_id, course_role, status ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{userId}, #{courseRole}, #{status} )
